e.title: insurance-changepoint
e.summary: 贝叶斯变点检测（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.0）：保险定价时间序列的结构突变识别
e.summary_en: Bayesian change-point detection (burning-cost, PyPI 0.1.0): structural breaks in insurance pricing time series
e.summary_hk: 貝葉斯變點檢測（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.0）：保險定價時間序列的結構突變識別
e.body: insurance-changepoint（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）做贝叶斯变点检测：保险定价时间序列的结构突变识别——费率水平/趋势何时发生不可逆变化。对 RIAA：变点是定价误估的重要来源——外部冲击（监管、竞争、通胀）改变损失成本结构，旧模型失效；与 [[insurance-dynamics]]（动态定价）、[[insurance-trend]]（趋势）配套；贝叶斯变点给出突变时间与不确定性（后验分布）——比「肉眼判断」严谨；与 [[insurance-monitoring]]（模型漂移检测）互补（变点=一次性结构变化，漂移=渐进）。
e.body_en: insurance-changepoint (burning-cost, PyPI v0.1.0) does Bayesian change-point detection: structural breaks in insurance pricing time series — when rate levels/trends change irreversibly. For RIAA: change points are a major source of pricing misestimation — external shocks (regulation, competition, inflation) change the loss-cost structure and invalidate old models; pairs with [[insurance-dynamics]] (dynamic pricing) and [[insurance-trend]] (trend); Bayesian change points give break times with uncertainty (posterior) — more rigorous than eyeballing; complements [[insurance-monitoring]] (drift = gradual, change point = one-off structural shift).
e.body_hk: insurance-changepoint（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）做貝葉斯變點檢測：保險定價時間序列的結構突變識別——費率水平/趨勢何時發生不可逆變化。對 RIAA：變點是定價誤估的重要來源——外部衝擊（監管、競爭、通脹）改變損失成本結構，舊模型失效；與 [[insurance-dynamics]]（動態定價）、[[insurance-trend]]（趨勢）配套；貝葉斯變點給出突變時間與不確定性（後驗分佈）——比「肉眼判斷」嚴謹；與 [[insurance-monitoring]]（模型漂移檢測）互補（變點=一次性結構變化，漂移=漸進）。
